request: Draw a lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset

parts.name: sunset_sky
parts.desc: Full-width rectangle filled with a vertical linear gradient from deep plum #2a1b3d at top through #5e3a6e and #c8553d to warm orange #ff8c42 at the horizon line y=400. It sits behind everything as the sky.

parts.name: setting_sun
parts.desc: Half-disc sun of radius 80 centered at (570,400), clipped at the horizon y=400, filled with a radial gradient from #fff3c4 at center to #f9c74f to #ff8c42 at the edge, plus a soft #f9c74f outer glow ring at low alpha. It peeks above the sea to the right of the lighthouse.

parts.name: sea
parts.desc: Rectangle from y=400 to the bottom with a vertical linear gradient from #c8553d at the horizon to #3b2f4a at the bottom. Add thin horizontal wavy bezier highlight strokes in #f9c74f and #fff3c4 at low alpha clustered below x=570 as the sun's reflection path.

parts.name: rocky_coast
parts.desc: Jagged, irregular rock mass drawn as a closed bezier/line path rising from the bottom-left edge to a lumpy plateau near y=380 around x=120-300, then sloping down into the sea near x=460. Fill with a linear gradient from #5e3a6e on the upper-left lit faces to #3b2f4a in shadow, with a few darker #2a1b3d crack lines and #c8553d rim-light edges on top-right facing the sun.

parts.name: lighthouse_tower
parts.desc: Tapered tower path, base 100px wide at y=390 narrowing to 64px at y=150, filled #f4ece1 with three horizontal #c8553d stripe bands following the taper. Shade the right third with a linear gradient to #5e3a6e at low alpha for roundness; it stands on the rocky plateau.

parts.name: lantern_room
parts.desc: Walkway gallery: a #3b2f4a rectangle 88px wide at y=146-154 with thin railing lines, then a 56px-wide glass lantern box from y=106-146 filled with a radial gradient of #fff3c4 to #f9c74f, with dark #3b2f4a vertical mullions. Topped by a #c8553d domed cap (quadratic curve) to y=90 with a small finial, sitting directly atop the tower.

parts.name: light_beams
parts.desc: Two translucent triangular beams fanning from the lantern center (220,126): one toward the upper left and one longer toward the right, filled with linear gradients from #fff3c4 at 0.5 alpha to transparent. Drawn over the sky for a glowing effect.

parts.name: seagulls
parts.desc: Three small seagull silhouettes as double-arc bezier 'M' strokes in #3b2f4a, 2px wide, of slightly varying sizes, scattered in the sky right of the lighthouse and above the sun.
